title: Intellia Therapeutics
summary: US clinical-stage gene-editing company using in-vivo CRISPR.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Intellia develops in-vivo CRISPR therapies delivered by lipid nanoparticles, aiming to edit genes directly inside the body for transthyretin amyloidosis and hereditary angioedema. It also works on ex-vivo cell therapies. Safety data from systemic editing are the critical milestone for the field.

Technology Exposure

  • In-vivo CRISPR therapies
  • Lipid-nanoparticle delivery
  • Ex-vivo cell engineering

What To Watch

  • Clinical safety and efficacy data
  • Regulatory path for in-vivo editing
  • Funding

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
